fusions.name: Strangler Vine
fusions.desc: Casts a link that deals 9 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Overgrowth
fusions.desc: Lashes roots around you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Root Garden
fusions.desc: Raises a rooted growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it, up to 4 tiles away.

fusions.name: Deep Taproot
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
